preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the LineAxis token to demonstrate the issue
Contract must not be frozen (frozen == false)

exploit_hint: The ERC20 approve() function incorrectly checks that the approval amount is less than the caller's balance instead of checking against allowance limits. This prevents legitimate approvals when the spender wants to approve more tokens than the owner currently holds. Call approve() with an amount greater than your current token balance to demonstrate the broken functionality.
